verdict.rationale: An identity platform could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Okta itself. The open-source MCP server lets external LLMs and agents query Okta data in natural language (e.g., failed logins, unused apps), but that is an integration building block for outside tools, not an in-product insight capability, so it earns no credit here.
